ack.coach-file: The player or the parent gave me the paper. I upload the redacted copy under the club's legal obligation; the parent sees on the child's profile that I submitted it.
ack.date: I am entering health data: the result and the date of the child's sport medical examination. {{club}} handles it under a legal obligation ({{law}}). The parent, the club's management and the coach see the result and the date. The club's privacy notice gives the details.
ack.file: I am uploading health data: the child's redacted sport medical certificate, with the result and the date. {{club}} handles it under a legal obligation ({{law}}). The parent and the management of the club that asks for the copy can open the file; the child's own account too if it gets the upload right; and the team's coach if the club allows it. The coach always sees the result and the expiry. The operator reaches it only with a reason, logged and visible to the club. The club's privacy notice gives the details.
ack.in-person: I saw {{name}}'s original sport medical certificate in person. Result: {{result}}{{until}}. The club handles the data under a legal obligation; the parent sees on the child's profile that I entered it.
ack.player-date: You are entering the result and the date of your sport medical paper. Your club must know it by law. {{parents}}the club's management and your coach see the result and the date. If you have a question, ask {{parentsAsk}}the club.
ack.player-file: You are entering the result and the date of your sport medical paper, and the redacted paper. Your club must know it by law. {{parents}}the club's management and your coach see the result and the date; {{parents}}the club's management, and your coach if the club allows it, see the paper. If you have a question, ask {{parentsAsk}}the club.

data-rule.title: What may be stored?
data-rule.intro: Under section 9 (1) of the decree, the sport medical licence must be recorded on paper or digitally. Annex 1 sets the required content. Among others:

items.person: the athlete's name, birth details and address;
items.sport: the sport and the athlete's status;
items.date: the date of the sport medical examination;

data-rule.important: Important: under the decree, the sport medical licence may not contain other health data.
